events.text: Is that a tower I can climb to reveal the map? No? Just a tower.
Nobody painted that. Which means I MUST touch it.
Let's see what this one does.
Every leaf is moving. Every single leaf.
I'm not leaving without that one.
Marking this spot. Back in a sec.
Ammo! For the gun I'll find later.
Nobody painted that. Which means I MUST touch it.
Back to where I left off.
A waystone! I can see the waystone!
I did it! All by myself!

profile.intro: Opens every chest, climbs every wall, reads every note. Lands anything, painted or not.
